name: io.github.sincekmori/asana-gate
title: asana-gate
description: Declarative access-control policy in front of the Asana API, served to AI agents over MCP.

environmentVariables.name: ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The Asana Personal Access Token the gate works with; not needed when one is saved with `asana-gate token set`.

environmentVariables.name: ASANA_GATE_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: The policy file to enforce; by default the project's .asana-gate/policy.yaml, else ~/.asana-gate/policy.yaml.
